content_blocks.label: clause_1._Premises
content_blocks.text: The Landlord hereby leases to the Tenant, and the Tenant hereby rents from the Landlord, the Premises located at 123 Main Street, Springfield City.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_Term_of_Lease
content_blocks.text: The term of this Lease shall commence on April 1, 2024, and shall expire on March 31, 2025, unless terminated earlier as provided herein.
